import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SubexpPolynomialSeriesAlgebra

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-! Correctness of the exact operand order used by the physical local CRT
controller: Pt times the negative seed, then series times seed, then inverse
times jet. No commutativity of the represented operations is assumed. -/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SubexpLocalSeriesCorrectness

open Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

variable {S A : Type*} [CommRing A]

theorem defect_denote (D : ℕ) (pt negativeSeed one : S)
    (add mul : S → S → S) (denote : S → A[X]) (P : A[X]) (b : A)
    (hpt : denote pt = Truncation.trunc D P)
    (hnegative : denote negativeSeed = Truncation.trunc D (C (-b)))
    (hone : denote one = Truncation.trunc D 1)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, denote (add x y) = denote x + denote y)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, denote (mul x y) = Truncation.trunc D (denote x * denote y)) :
    denote (add (mul pt negativeSeed) one) = Truncation.trunc D (1 - C b * P) := by
  rw [hadd, hmul, hpt, hnegative, SubexpTruncatedGeometric.trunc_mul_trunc,
    hone, ← Truncation.trunc_add]
  congr 1
  rw [map_neg]
  ring

theorem inverse_denote (D μ : ℕ) (zero one z cb : S)
    (add mul : S → S → S) (denote : S → A[X]) (P : A[X]) (b : A)
    (hzero : denote zero = 0) (hone : denote one = Truncation.trunc D 1)
    (hz : denote z = Truncation.trunc D (1 - C b * P))
    (hcb : denote cb = Truncation.trunc D (C b))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, denote (add x y) = denote x + denote y)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, denote (mul x y) = Truncation.trunc D (denote x * denote y)) :
    denote (mul (((fun acc => add (mul acc z) one)^[D + μ]) zero) cb) =
      SubexpResiduePolynomialInverse.inverse P b D μ := by
  rw [hmul, hcb,
    SubexpPolynomialSeriesAlgebra.horner_denote D zero one z add mul denote _
      hzero hone hz hadd hmul,
    SubexpTruncatedGeometric.trunc_mul_trunc]
  change Truncation.trunc D (_ * C b) = Truncation.trunc D (C b * _)
  rw [mul_comm]

theorem correction_denote (D μ : ℕ) (zero one z cb jet : S)
    (add mul : S → S → S) (denote : S → A[X]) (P J : A[X]) (a b : A)
    (hzero : denote zero = 0) (hone : denote one = Truncation.trunc D 1)
    (hz : denote z = Truncation.trunc D (1 - C b * P))
    (hcb : denote cb = Truncation.trunc D (C b)) (hjet : denote jet = J)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, denote (add x y) = denote x + denote y)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, denote (mul x y) = Truncation.trunc D (denote x * denote y))
    (ha : a * P.coeff 0 = 1) (hb : (1 - b * P.coeff 0) ^ μ = 0) :
    denote (mul (mul (((fun acc => add (mul acc z) one)^[D + μ]) zero) cb) jet) =
      TruncatedInverse.correctedJet P J a D := by
  rw [hmul, hjet, inverse_denote D μ zero one z cb add mul denote P b
    hzero hone hz hcb hadd hmul, SubexpResiduePolynomialInverse.inverse_eq P a b D μ ha hb]
  unfold TruncatedInverse.correctedJet
  rw [mul_comm]

import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SubexpClauseScopeCorrectness
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SubexpClauseFamilyProgram
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-!
# Scope payloads and degree in the physical leaf order

The unary prefix and clause-family outputs have exactly the factor order
used by the semantic system. Inner scope order is the actual last-occurrence
order; only membership is used by the incidence counter.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SubexpLeafScopeOrder

open Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem Subexp.IncidencePlanSpec

variable {n ell p k B : ℕ}

def rawScopes (G : SubexpLeafData.Leaf n) (hG : (G.map ExecCNF.clauseSet).Nodup)
    (hell : 0 < ell) : List (List ℕ) :=
  Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem.rawScopes (SubexpLeafData.factors G hG)
    (SubexpLeafData.scopes G hG (ChunkPartition.indexEquiv n ell hell))

private theorem unary_values (D : ℕ) :
    ((List.finRange D).map (fun j => [j])).map (List.map Fin.val) =
      (List.range D).map List.singleton := by
  rw [List.map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_coe_finRange D, List.map_map]
  rfl

theorem rawScopes_eq_stream (G : SubexpLeafData.Leaf n)
    (hG : (G.map ExecCNF.clauseSet).Nodup) (hell : 0 < ell) :
    rawScopes G hG hell =
      (List.range (ChunkPartition.count n ell)).map List.singleton ++
      (G.map (SubexpLeafData.clauseScope (ChunkPartition.indexEquiv n ell hell))).map
        (List.map Fin.val) := by
  have h := congrArg (List.map (List.map Fin.val))
    (SubexpLeafData.scope_stream G hG (ChunkPartition.indexEquiv n ell hell))
  rw [List.map_append, unary_values] at h
  simpa only [rawScopes, Subexp.OrderedScopeSystem.rawScopes, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def] using h

theorem family_scopes_eq (c : SubexpClauseFamilyProgram.Inputs)
    (hv : SubexpClauseFamilyProgram.Valid c
      (ChunkPartition.count n (BinaryArithmetic.toNat c.binaryEll)) n)
    (G : SubexpLeafData.Leaf n) :
    SubexpClauseFamilyProgram.scopes c G =
      (G.map (SubexpLeafData.clauseScope
        (ChunkPartition.indexEquiv n (BinaryArithmetic.toNat c.binaryEll) hv.ell_pos))).map
          (fun scope => Encoding.encodeList Encoding.encodeNat (scope.map Fin.val)) := by
  simp only [SubexpClauseFamilyProgram.scopes, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ls hls
  exact SubexpClauseScopeCorrectness.scopeBytes_eq_canonical
    (SubexpClauseFamilyCallback.withClause c ls) ls hv.ell_pos
    (SubexpClauseFamilyCallback.validClause c hv ls)

import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.LeanCompat
import OAI.Algorithms.SubexponentialSAT.SubexpExtractionJobs

namespace OAI.Algorithms

/-!
# Accumulator invariant for the extraction-job machine

This file concerns the mathematical contents of the packed jet array.  The
runtime implementation is the fixed read/add/replace program; the functions
below express its per-cell invariant and do not stand in for machine steps.
-/

namespace SubexponentialSAT.SubexpJetAccumulator

open SubexpExtractionJobs

section FiniteFold

variable {α R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]

def addAt (index : α → ℕ) (value : α → R) (cells : ℕ → R) (a : α) : ℕ → R :=
  Function.update cells (index a) (cells (index a) + value a)

/-- A sequence of single-cell additions has the expected sum at every cell,
without an assumption about the order of jobs. -/
theorem fold_addAt (index : α → ℕ) (value : α → R) (as : List α)
    (cells : ℕ → R) (r : ℕ) :
    (as.foldl (addAt index value) cells) r =
      cells r + (as.map fun a => if index a = r then value a else 0).sum := by
  induction as generalizing cells with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      by_cases h : index a = r
      · unfold addAt
        rw [h]
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        exact add_assoc _ _ _
      · have hr : r ≠ index a := Ne.symm h
        simp [addAt, h, hr]

/-- An implementation that performs exactly the stated update at every step
satisfies the same invariant. This is the bridge used for concrete array
read/add/replace traces. -/
theorem fold_step_refinement {σ : Type*} (step : σ → α → σ)
    (contents : σ → ℕ → R) (index : α → ℕ) (value : α → R)
    (hstep : ∀ s a, contents (step s a) = addAt index value (contents s) a)
    (as : List α) (s : σ) (r : ℕ) :
    contents (as.foldl step s) r =
      contents s r + (as.map fun a => if index a = r then value a else 0).sum := by
  have hfold : contents (as.foldl step s) = as.foldl (addAt index value) (contents s) := by
    induction as generalizing s with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a as ih =>

# MODULE: qsa_cache_index_topk
The QSA paged KV cache, the pooled-key indexer and the exact threshold top-k selection
(`src/kernels/cuda/qsa.cu`): page/row addressing, the f32 order key, the ascending
"greater-than plus first equals" walk, the single-writer step state, and the gather decomposition.

## Source semantics
* A pool row is `[page][kv_head][page_size][head_dim]`, row = `(page*kvHeads + h)*pageSize + slot`.
* `order_key` is a total order on f32 bit patterns as unsigned ints (negative: `~b`, else `b | 2^31`).
* `topk_kernel` emits every cell strictly above the threshold key and the first
  `width - c_gt` cells equal to it, walking ascending, so the result has exactly `width` ids
  whenever `c_gt <= width <= c_gt + c_eq`.
* `qsa_step_fill` derives `n_kv = pos+1`, `n_bid = n_kv / r`, `width = min n_kv (topK + r - 1)` from one position.
* `kv_gather` splits a flat thread index into `(id, head, quad)` and writes `dst = i`.

## Form template identifiers
* `poolRow`      <- pool row index in `kv_append_kernel` / `kv_gather_kernel`
* `orderKey`     <- `order_key`
* `walk`         <- the emit loop of `topk_kernel`
* `stepFill`     <- `qsa_step_fill`
* `kvIndex`      <- `h / (n_head / n_head_kv)` (NOT `h % n_head_kv`)
-/

namespace QsaCacheIndexTopk

-- § pool addressing

/-- Row of a cell inside the paged pool. -/
def poolRow (page kvHeads h pageSize slot : Nat) : Nat :=
  (page * kvHeads + h) * pageSize + slot

/-- Every in-range (page, head, slot) maps to a row inside the pool. -/
theorem poolRow_lt (page kvHeads h pageSize slot nPages : Nat)
    (hp : page < nPages) (hh : h < kvHeads) (hs : slot < pageSize) :
    poolRow page kvHeads h pageSize slot < nPages * kvHeads * pageSize := by
  unfold poolRow
  have h0 : (page + 1) * kvHeads ≤ nPages * kvHeads := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp
  have h0' : (page + 1) * kvHeads = page * kvHeads + kvHeads := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  have h1 : page * kvHeads + h + 1 ≤ nPages * kvHeads := by omega
  have h2 : (page * kvHeads + h + 1) * pageSize ≤ nPages * kvHeads * pageSize :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h1
  have h2' : (page * kvHeads + h + 1) * pageSize = (page * kvHeads + h) * pageSize + pageSize := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  omega

/-- The query head to KV head map is a division by the group size, and lands in range. -/
theorem kvIndex_lt (nHead nHeadKv h : Nat) (hd : nHead % nHeadKv = 0) (hh : h < nHead) :
    h / (nHead / nHeadKv) < nHeadKv := by
  apply Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
  have e := Nat.div_add_mod nHead nHeadKv
  have c := Nat.mul_comm nHeadKv (nHead / nHeadKv)
  omega

-- § order key

/-- The unsigned order key of an f32 bit pattern `b < 2^32`. -/
def orderKey (b : Nat) : Nat :=
  if 2147483648 ≤ b then 4294967295 - b else b + 2147483648

/-- The key fits in 32 bits. -/
theorem orderKey_lt (b : Nat) (hb : b < 4294967296) : orderKey b < 4294967296 := by
  unfold orderKey
  split <;> omega

/-- Distinct bit patterns get distinct keys. -/
theorem orderKey_inj (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 4294967296) (hb : b < 4294967296)

/-- Slot of a position within its block. -/
def slotOf (pos : Nat) : Nat := pos % 4

  omega

  unfold slotOf

  unfold slotOf
  omega

  unfold slotOf at h3

The sampler chain's deterministic parts (`src/kernels/cuda/sampler.cu`): the block-parallel greedy argmax
with lowest-index tie rule, the penalty window, the repeat/frequency/presence penalty, the top-k clamp,
and the Philox-to-uniform conversion.

## Source semantics
* Greedy = argmax over penalised logits; each thread keeps `if (s > bv)` over a strided subset, and the
  reduction picks the larger value, on equality the SMALLER index; `n_vocab` is the "no candidate" index.
* An all `-inf` row yields index 0.
* Penalty window is the TAIL of the history: `hlen = clamp(penalty_last_n, 0, history_len)`, start `history_len - hlen`.
* Repeat penalty multiplies non-positive logits and divides positive ones; presence is a boolean, not the count.
* `top_k` is clamped to 64; `top_k <= 0` is refused on the sampled path.
* Uniform = `(c0 >> 8) / 2^24`, strictly below 1.

## Form template identifiers
* `merge`       <- the shuffle/shared-memory candidate combine
* `windowLen`   <- `hlen`
* `presence`    <- `(count > 0 ? 1 : 0) * penalty_present`
* `topKClamp`   <- `k`
-/

namespace SamplerGreedyPenalties

-- § candidate merge

/-- Combine two (value, index) candidates: larger value wins, equal values prefer the smaller index. -/
def merge (a b : Int × Nat) : Int × Nat :=
  if b.1 > a.1 ∨ (b.1 = a.1 ∧ b.2 < a.2) then b else a

/-- Merging is commutative, so the reduction order does not matter. -/
theorem merge_comm (a b : Int × Nat) : merge a b = merge b a := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨bv, bi⟩ := b
  unfold merge
  by_cases h1 : bv > av ∨ (bv = av ∧ bi < ai)
  · have h2 : ¬ (av > bv ∨ (av = bv ∧ ai < bi)) := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, if_true, if_false]
  · by_cases h2 : av > bv ∨ (av = bv ∧ ai < bi)
    · simp only [h1, h2, if_true, if_false]
    · have : av = bv ∧ ai = bi := by omega
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := this
      subst e1
      subst e2
      simp only [h1, if_false]

/-- A real candidate (index below `n_vocab`) with value at least the sentinel's beats the sentinel. -/
theorem merge_sentinel (v sv : Int) (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hv : sv ≤ v) :
    merge (sv, n) (v, i) = (v, i) := by
  unfold merge
  have h : v > sv ∨ (v = sv ∧ i < n) := by omega
  simp only [h, if_true]

/-- The result of a merge is one of its inputs. -/
theorem merge_mem (a b : Int × Nat) : merge a b = a ∨ merge a b = b := by
  unfold merge
  split
  · right; rfl
  · left; rfl

theorem merge_ge (a b : Int × Nat) : a.1 ≤ (merge a b).1 ∧ b.1 ≤ (merge a b).1 := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨bv, bi⟩ := b
  unfold merge
  by_cases h : bv > av ∨ (bv = av ∧ bi < ai)
  · simp only [h, if_true]

  · simp only [h, if_false]

  unfold finalIndex
  split <;> omega

  unfold windowLen

    (histLen - windowLen lastN histLen) + windowLen lastN histLen = histLen := by
  omega

/-- Repeat penalty: multiply non-positive logits, divide positive ones (integer model of the ordering). -/
def repeatPen (logit rep : Int) : Int := if logit ≤ 0 then logit * rep else logit / rep

  if count = 0 then logit

theorem presence_const (c1 c2 : Nat) (pen : Int) (h1 : 0 < c1) (h2 : 0 < c2) :
    presence c1 pen = presence c2 pen := by
  unfold presence
  rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]

/-- Unity penalties on a positive logit leave it unchanged when the other terms are zero. -/
theorem repeatPen_one_pos (logit : Int) (h : 0 < logit) : repeatPen logit 1 = logit := by
  unfold repeatPen
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  simp

/-- Top-k clamp: `top_k` in `1..64`, zero means "refuse". -/

/-- The clamp never exceeds the 64-slot keep array. -/

  unfold topKClamp
  split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- A positive request gets at least one slot. -/

  unfold topKClamp
  split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- The 24-bit numerator of the uniform is below the denominator `2^24`, so the draw is in `[0, 1)`. -/

  omega

  if b.1 > a.1 ∨ (b.1 = a.1 ∧ b.2 < a.2) then b else a

/-- Merging is commutative, so the reduction order does not matter. -/
theorem merge_comm (a b : Int × Nat) : merge a b = merge b a := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨bv, bi⟩ := b
  unfold merge
  by_cases h1 : bv > av ∨ (bv = av ∧ bi < ai)
  · have h2 : ¬ (av > bv ∨ (av = bv ∧ ai < bi)) := by omega
    simp only [h1, h2, if_true, if_false]
  · by_cases h2 : av > bv ∨ (av = bv ∧ ai < bi)
    · simp only [h1, h2, if_true, if_false]
    · have : av = bv ∧ ai = bi := by omega
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := this
      subst e1
      subst e2
      simp only [h1, if_false]

/-- A real candidate (index below `n_vocab`) with value at least the sentinel's beats the sentinel. -/
theorem merge_sentinel (v sv : Int) (i n : Nat) (hi : i < n) (hv : sv ≤ v) :
    merge (sv, n) (v, i) = (v, i) := by
  unfold merge
  have h : v > sv ∨ (v = sv ∧ i < n) := by omega
  simp only [h, if_true]

/-- The result of a merge is one of its inputs. -/
theorem merge_mem (a b : Int × Nat) : merge a b = a ∨ merge a b = b := by
  unfold merge
  split
  · right; rfl
  · left; rfl

/-- The result is never smaller (in value) than either input. -/
theorem merge_ge (a b : Int × Nat) : a.1 ≤ (merge a b).1 ∧ b.1 ≤ (merge a b).1 := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨bv, bi⟩ := b
  unfold merge
  by_cases h : bv > av ∨ (bv = av ∧ bi < ai)
  · simp only [h, if_true]
    omega
  · simp only [h, if_false]
    omega

/-- The fallback for an all `-inf` row: index `n_vocab` becomes 0. -/
def finalIndex (wi nVocab : Nat) : Nat := if wi < nVocab then wi else 0

/-- The emitted token is always a valid vocabulary index. -/
theorem finalIndex_lt (wi nVocab : Nat) (h : 0 < nVocab) : finalIndex wi nVocab < nVocab := by
  unfold finalIndex
  split <;> omega

-- § penalty window

/-- Window length: `penalty_last_n` clamped into `[0, history_len]`. -/
def windowLen (lastN histLen : Int) : Int := if lastN < histLen then (if lastN < 0 then 0 else lastN) else histLen

/-- The window fits in the history. -/
theorem windowLen_le (lastN histLen : Int) (h : 0 ≤ histLen) : 0 ≤ windowLen lastN histLen ∧
    windowLen lastN histLen ≤ histLen := by
  unfold windowLen
  split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- The window is the tail: start offset plus length is the history length. -/
theorem window_tail (lastN histLen : Int) (h : 0 ≤ histLen) :
    (histLen - windowLen lastN histLen) + windowLen lastN histLen = histLen := by
  omega

-- § penalties

/-- Repeat penalty: multiply non-positive logits, divide positive ones (integer model of the ordering). -/
def repeatPen (logit rep : Int) : Int := if logit ≤ 0 then logit * rep else logit / rep

/-- Presence term: boolean, not the count. -/
def presence (count : Nat) (pen : Int) : Int := if 0 < count then pen else 0

/-- A token that never appeared keeps its logit (the kernel returns early for `count <= 0`). -/
def applyPen (logit : Int) (count : Nat) (rep freq pres : Int) : Int :=
  if count = 0 then logit
  else repeatPen logit rep - (count : Int) * freq - presence count pres

/-- Unseen tokens are untouched. -/
theorem applyPen_unseen (logit rep freq pres : Int) : applyPen logit 0 rep freq pres = logit := by
  simp [applyPen]

/-- The presence term does not grow with the count. -/
theorem presence_const (c1 c2 : Nat) (pen : Int) (h1 : 0 < c1) (h2 : 0 < c2) :
    presence c1 pen = presence c2 pen := by
  unfold presence
  rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]

/-- Unity penalties on a positive logit leave it unchanged when the other terms are zero. -/
theorem repeatPen_one_pos (logit : Int) (h : 0 < logit) : repeatPen logit 1 = logit := by
  unfold repeatPen
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  simp

-- § sampling parameters

/-- Top-k clamp: `top_k` in `1..64`, zero means "refuse". -/
def topKClamp (topK : Int) : Int := if topK > 0 then (if topK < 64 then topK else 64) else 0

/-- The clamp never exceeds the 64-slot keep array. -/
theorem topKClamp_le (topK : Int) : 0 ≤ topKClamp topK ∧ topKClamp topK ≤ 64 := by
  unfold topKClamp
  split <;> (try split) <;> omega

/-- A positive request gets at least one slot. -/
theorem topKClamp_pos (topK : Int) (h : 0 < topK) : 1 ≤ topKClamp topK := by
  unfold topKClamp
  split <;> (try split) <;> omega

-- § Philox uniform

/-- The 24-bit numerator of the uniform is below the denominator `2^24`, so the draw is in `[0, 1)`. -/
theorem uniform_lt_one (c0 : Nat) (h : c0 < 4294967296) : c0 / 256 < 16777216 := by
  omega

end SamplerGreedyPenalties
